interface.shortDescription: Bookmark research with sources · 书签研究与来源核验
interface.longDescription: Query canvas snapshots or live directories, research complete sources with host workflows, and save evidence-linked reports and Wiki pages. 保留全部来源与重复书签语境，复用宿主子代理或工作流，结合搜索与可选专业研究 API，核验证据和覆盖，保存报告与 Wiki。
defaultPrompt: Quick check / 快速查证：Read my selected bookmark and answer with sources. 读取指定书签并带来源回答。
Compare / 主动搜索：Compare tools in my selected cards and follow evidence gaps. 比较指定卡片并补查证据。
Deep research / 深度研究：Research every URL in my package; save a report and Wiki. 全量研究并核验覆盖。
